galaxy.bio_tools_summary: Galaxy Image Analysis enables web-based and cloud-based analysis of cell microscopy images and quantification of cellular phenotypes. The software provides tools and workflows for image enhancement, cell segmentation, feature extraction, image registration, object tracking, visualization, and performance evaluation. By building on the European Galaxy server and its HPC infrastructure, Galaxy Image Analysis supports reproducible and accessible image analysis workflows for high-content and high-throughput microscopy data. Galaxy Image Analysis is mainly developed by the Biomedical Computer Vision (BMCV) Group at Heidelberg University.
